variants.candidate: Your Expression is the gate where inner work becomes outer fact. Earth makes it slow and solid, made to last. As a catalyst, the gate sticks, and you give quietly rather than show what you can do. You pay in kindness not given and talent not shown.
variants.original: Earth is your Expression, and as a catalyst, it is your heat becoming things that last: lessons taught, systems written down, gatherings that become traditions. You are at your best converting enthusiasm into something others can stand on.

variants.candidate: Your Mind is where the world soaks in and becomes yours. Wood makes it grow. As a catalyst, the intake falls behind the output, and you would rather puzzle an answer out alone than take one from a teacher. Either way you run dry before you feel taught.
variants.original: Wood is your Mind, and as a catalyst, it is how your fuel accumulates: skills stacked, books finished, friendships tended, people learned from over years. What you gather quietly becomes what you later spend as brilliance.

variants.candidate: Your Order is the rules you answer to and the rank you hold by them. Water makes it cool and deep, and a rule settles in quietly. As a catalyst, the pull stays faint, so you answer a crisis more than you build a career and let your rank slip.
variants.original: Water is your Order, and as a catalyst, it is the cool check your intensity needs: reviews, budgets, one person whose calm questions slow you down before the leap. Your best decisions have all survived a night of doubt.

variants.candidate: Your Body is the strength the whole of you stands on. Fire makes it warm, so you recover by doing. Running thin, the reserve goes first, and you go alone ahead of asking a peer or bet bold instead of rest. You pay for each bright day with lost rest.
variants.original: Fire is your Body, and running thin, it is the energy behind your warmth: sociability, drive, the lift that makes mornings possible. Yours runs in bursts, so depletion shows as dimness with people you love.

variants.candidate: Your Action is what you go and build, claim and provide. Metal makes it exact, so what you take on ends finished or not at all. As a catalyst, you have more drive than work for it, and you chase the next opening more than you finish anything to keep.
variants.original: Metal is your Action, and as a catalyst, it is your heat applied to hard, valuable problems: negotiations, difficult skills, work that resists until it yields. Easy tasks waste you.
